combo_label: The Garage × Cricket × The Moon Landings

entries.clue: First human to set foot on another world, in July 1969
Lander that set the first two men down on the Sea of Tranquillity in 1969
Stitched ridge circling the ball, landed on deliberately by quick men
Petrol-driven cutter wheeled out weekly to shorten the grass.
Coin spun by the captains, its winner choosing whether to bat or bowl
Shaggy-headed swab on a long stick for washing down a hard floor.
Its name a byword for a long, eventful journey, the craft that limped home in 1970
Skipper of the 1971 flight who swung a makeshift club at two balls out there
Tinned colour for walls and woodwork, its lid welded on by a dried skin.
Runs credited for a stroke that reaches the perimeter along the ground
A side's spell of batting, over once ten of its members are out
Flaky orange corrosion eating a neglected wing arch from the inside.
